text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, the first report in this channel is your 10:42 AM post on 3 Aug, which says the gate kiosks are offline at the Hartford plant, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. The channel times have no zone attached, so check the postmortem's timezone against that.

From the channel, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard at that point. The only other guard entry is at 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported kiosk 1 back and that the guard had checked in trailer 8836. The channel doesn't record what the guard did between those two posts.
